text:
Alice: Starting perf validation for eu-west3 cluster bring-up. Bootstrapped 12 g5 nodes. Need kernel/driver, network, and throughput baselines. I'll paste smoke run shortly.

infra-bot: cluster eu-west3: 12/12 nodes Ready. kube-proxy and cni up. AMI: redwood-gpu-2026-03-10.

Ben: Quick checklist to run on a canary node before we hand off: kernel version, nvidia-driver, CUDA, RDMA presence, NIC firmware, MTU, IRQ affinity, hugepages, swap off, vm.swappiness, nccl-tests, and a single-GPU inference smoke. Commands:
```
ssh node-03
uname -r
nvidia-smi -q | head
cat /etc/nvidia/version || dpkg -l | grep nvidia
nvidia-bug-report.sh --capture-logs
ethtool -S eth0
ethtool -k eth0
```

Carla: Ran quick kernel check on node-03: `5.15.0-110-gpu`. driver 535.54.03, CUDA 12.1. No RDMA devices detected. NIC: Intel X710 fw 1.35. MTU: 1500 across nodes.

Dan: iperf3 node-03 -> node-07 (1500 MTU): `9.2 Gbits/sec`. When I set MTU 9000 on both ends I measured `11.6 Gbits/sec`. Not reaching expected ~20G on 25G link. Command: `iperf3 -c node-07 -P 4 -t 30`.

Ben: We expect ~18-22G for parallel streams on a 25G link. Check switch config: flow-control, LACP, and transceiver types. Also confirm SR-IOV and VF offsets are consistent. For now keep SR-IOV disabled.

SRE Oncall: FYI kernel TCP autotuning defaults can cause tail latency. Baseline sysctls to set on nodes: `net.core.rmem_max=16777216` and `net.ipv4.tcp_rmem='4096 87380 16777216'`. Also set `net.core.netdev_max_backlog=250000` during testing.

Carla: Model smoke run (toy GPT-like) on 1xA10, seq_len=1024, batch=1: tokens/sec=4200, p50=18ms, p95=46ms, p99=120ms. By comparison sfo baseline: tokens/sec=4800, p95=38ms. So eu-west3 ~12% slower on tokens/sec and slightly worse tail.

Alice: Potential causes: PCIe link speed, NIC offloads, switch port config, driver mismatch, or kernel preemption settings. Please collect `lspci -vv` and `dmesg | grep -i nvrm` and attach.

Dan: Found driver on some nodes installed from apt was 535.44 instead of 535.54. Scheduling driver upgrade on canary node now. :construction::skin-tone-3:

infra-bot: action created: `update-driver node-03 -> 535.54` (created by Dan). Referencing runbook /runbooks/perf/eu-west3-bootstrap for steps.

Ben: After driver upgrade + enabling jumbo MTU across host network and pod network, please rerun: `nccl-tests -b 8 -e 512M -f 2` and the inference smoke. Also collect `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` to record GPU util over the run.

Carla: I'll run the full suite on canary node-03 then roll to 3 nodes. Handoff criteria to ENG oncall: tokens/sec within 95% of sfo baseline AND p95 <= 40ms. ETA ~2 hours.

Alice: Thanks all — adding findings into the perf validation doc and tagging the handoff checklist. Ping if the driver restore or switch firmware blocks the run.
